Q: (Ab)using ASP.NET Core for non-http message processing? A:

As mentioned, there are ways to use SignalR or other packages to handle different protocols.

But that does not address fully your question I think.

Your original idea might be very hard to implement, because entire pipeline is meant to work with HTTP request, so you would have to mock or "pass through" any data from and to HTTP request/response, and i don't think so any protocol would fit into request response pattern. So it could be near impossible to mimic HTTP request in some cases.
